typing.old_operator: A_a=I+P_a^h G restricted to V_a, mapping V_a to V_a
typing.exterior_charge: Gamma_(a,b)=P_(W_(a,b))^h G restricted to V_a, mapping V_a to W_(a,b)
typing.block_warning: The older cross-block C maps collar to old; Gamma is its adjoint. Gamma=T A is the typed orientation.
typing.dense_core_warning: Use the bounded form-operator convention, or separately prove an unbounded operator/graph-core bridge.

factorization_classification: Gamma=T A implies ker(A) subset ker(Gamma).
The quotient T0(Ax)=Gamma x is algebraically well-defined iff KNC holds.
A bounded factor exists iff norm(Gamma x)<=M norm(Ax), equivalently Gamma*Gamma<=M^2 A^2, equivalently ran(Gamma*) subset ran(A).
At A=I+compact the range is closed, so KNC and existence of a bounded factor are equivalent.
A closable factor identity on a dense core forces KNC; a nonclosable factor can fake the identity.
Full block positivity gives square-root Schur alignment but not a uniform linear A-factor before contact.

exact_falsifiers.same_A_different_charge: A=diag(1,0), D=1, with good charge x1 and bad charge x2; the bad null/collar direction has value -1.
exact_falsifiers.square_root_family: [[r^2,r],[r,1]] is PSD and exact rank one, while its nonzero scalar A-factor has norm 1/r.
exact_falsifiers.shifted_resolvent: On a charged zero mode the shifted factor is -1/sigma and reconstructs the charge but has a reciprocal pole.
exact_falsifiers.nonclosed_range: A e_n=4^-n e_n and Gamma x=sum 4^-n x_n give a PSD completion whose quotient factor is not closable.
exact_falsifiers.dense_core_fake: On C plus ell2, the summation graph core is dense and supports Gamma=T A although the true kernel vector is charged; T is nonclosable.

backward_strip.hypothesis: For fixed eta in (0,1/2], eta<=Re(rho)<=1-eta for every nontrivial zero.
backward_strip.licensed_energy_consequence: Every regular complete fixed-window R71/R68 block is <=exp((1-2eta+o(1))R).
backward_strip.factorization_nonpromotion: Universal unshifted exterior factorization is RH-equivalent under the accepted interfaces. Deriving it from the strip would be a strip-to-RH amplifier, not an intermediate strip lemma.
backward_strip.coercivity_nonpromotion: Strip geometry and zero counting alone lose a half Fourier derivative and do not imply the desired localized-Weil spectral floor.
